name: DupeFont
original_description: Show DupeFont a screenshot, photo, logo or design and it reads the typography, then ranks the closest free and open-source look-alikes. Every match comes with a similarity score, its licence, a live preview, and a link to its Google Fonts page or to a DupeFont page with more alternatives. Results are always openly licensed fonts.

limitations_ja: 実際の一致精度やライセンス条件は未検証。
